title: Zesty Juicy Middle Eastern Paneer Mansaf
description: A spicy and juicy Middle Eastern dish featuring paneer, cooked in a tagine and served in a mansaf style, perfect for special occasions.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in the tagine over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute.
Add the cumin, coriander, cayenne pepper, salt, and black pepper, and cook for 1 minute.
Add the paneer cubes and cook until they start to brown, about 5 minutes.
Add the chicken broth and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Serve the paneer and sauce over a bed of rice or bread, in a mansaf style.
Garnish with fresh parsley or cilantro, if desired.
Serve with a side of lazy-susan-spinner for a show-off presentation.
Cook poultry to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F before serving.
